data.one_liner: A pre-built Flutter circular animator widget for profiles or other widgets.
data.what_it_does: It surrounds any given Flutter widget with animated circular rings using custom colors, speeds, and curves. It supports configurable inner and outer animations, durations, and reverse directions.
use_when: You want to animate a profile picture or avatar with circular rings.
You need a simple pre-built circular animation widget without manual animation controller setup.
avoid_when: You need complex physics-based custom animations beyond simple circular strokes.
You are building a game or an advanced vector animation requiring Rive or Lottie.
strengths: Supports all standard Flutter curve animations.
Highly configurable inner and outer colors, sizes, durations, and directions.
weaknesses: Limited to circular ring animations around a widget.
Not documented for complex multi-widget sequential animations.
